Geometry-based classification

The analyzer reads analytic STEP surfaces in your browser. Parallel planes suggest sheet thickness; paired bend faces indicate formed sheet; concentric cylindrical walls indicate tube. Hardware and uncertain geometry stay in Review. Confirm all results against CAD before ordering or cutting.
